projects.title: Intention — Direction and Purpose
projects.description: Sets the goal and drives all downstream processing. Without intention, perception has no filter. Design phase.

projects.title: Perception — ELO Substrate
projects.description: Semantic token compression. Every word and phrase maps to a canonical ID. 20.1% fewer tokens vs Qwen BBPE; 46.7% wire-format reduction. Vocabulary contract v0.3.1 shipped.

projects.title: Memory — Mneme
projects.description: Temporal wave storage over MemorySeeds. 4D cosine retrieval — no ML dependency. Activation under 2ms across 10,000 seeds. Source-agnostic: transcripts, books, news, conversations.

projects.title: Wonder — Curiosity and Exploration
projects.description: Detects gaps in the knowledge graph, generates questions, and triggers growth points when query confidence falls below threshold.

projects.title: Emotion — Weight and Significance
projects.description: EPA — Evaluation, Potency, Activity — assigns every token a 3D semantic coordinate, so the system knows what matters. Built as a projection inside Mneme.

projects.title: Reasoning — Structure and Logic
projects.description: Applies rules to seeds: contradiction detection, stage classification (0–5), and probability inference over the seed graph.

projects.title: Connection — Linking Knowledge
projects.description: The SeedFlow graph connects MemorySeeds across entities and time via 4D cosine proximity. Built as a layer inside Mneme.

projects.title: Reflection — Learning and Improvement
projects.description: Scores contradiction pairs surfaced by Memory, then promotes, compresses, and matures seeds over time. Feeds back into the system.
